name: Timeline simulator S05 shows the expected invoice breakdown
description: Verify the shipped S05 scenario displays the known golden invoice totals and line items.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page, click 'Simulator' in the top navigation bar, and choose 'S05' in the 'Load scenario' dropdown
Assert the '✅ Matches golden expected' badge is shown
Assert exactly 2 invoices: Invoice 1 dated 2027-01-01 totals $29.00, Invoice 2 dated 2027-02-01 totals $103.20 with lines -$14.03, $38.23 and $79.00
